text:
Liam O'Neill: quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: teams asked for firm windows for three things — streaming API beta/GA, Console rollout controls (canaries/weights/fallbacks), and Optimize suggestion pilot. want short, actionable timelines and blockers.

Sophia Lee: TL;DR targets: streaming beta = Aug 2026 (public beta), streaming GA = Nov 2026. Console rollout controls beta = Sep/Oct 2026, GA = Jan 2027. Optimize suggestions pilot = Dec 2026; GA depends on pilot results (early 2027 tentative). these are targets.

Marta Ivanova: engineering caveat: streaming beta in Aug requires client SDK streaming helpers merged by 2026-07-05 and kernel ops freeze by 2026-06-18. current blocker: intermittent KV eviction spike under concurrent writes. tracking a fix but it may add a 2-3 week risk.

Ben Cho: infra note: Dedicated customers get a staggered rollout — approx 5-7 weeks after hosted beta for validation and capacity mapping. private/on-prem always on request post-GA. network telemetry for rollout toggles mostly in place.

Aria (product): Console specifics: we'll ship presets (5%, 20%, 50%, 100%), a custom slider, and three policy modes (latency-first, cost-first, reliability-first). initial UI will surface per-route approximate token cost and p95/p99 latency. auto-fallback will be a Boolean + threshold config.

Liam O'Neill: will Optimize be suggestions-only or an automated controller?

Aria (product): suggestions-only first (UI + CLI) — owners review and accept. suggestions include batching window (ms), KV cache TTL, and quantization profile hints (int8 / int8+afternorm). we'll deliver a small eval harness and example prompts so teams can measure quality impact.

Marta Ivanova: QA note: we need owners to run the harness during the pilot. QA-bot will schedule integration tests against the suggested configs.

ops-bot: [automated] Canaries for streaming infra scheduled 2026-06-10 02:00 UTC — expect ~10m validation window and temporary throttle of non-prod traffic.

Liam O'Neill: concrete asks and deadlines:
- Product (Aria): attach eval harness + canonical prompts to the roadmap ticket by 2026-06-12
- Eng (Marta): confirm kernel/ops freeze date and KV eviction regression status by 2026-06-15
- Infra (Ben): publish Dedicated validation plan and expected lag window by 2026-06-09
- QA: schedule pilot integration runs and share pass/fail checklist by 2026-06-20

Sophia Lee: I'll collate these into a short follow-up doc and a milestone board. if any owner thinks dates are unrealistic, please flag by EOD 2026-05-27. thanks all. :rocket:

Marta Ivanova: noted. starting a bug PR for KV eviction now — will ping when CI reproduces.

Ben Cho: will post the Dedicated validation checklist in the roadmap ticket by tomorrow.

Aria (product): adding presets UI mockups to the ticket later today.

Liam O'Neill: great thread 9 — helps teams plan sprints.
